scripts.dev: bash -c 'set -a; source .env; set +a; npm run dev:server & server_pid=$!; trap "kill ${server_pid} 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT INT TERM; npm run dev:web -- --host 0.0.0.0'
scripts.dev:external: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; compose=(docker --context docker-host compose -f "$PWD/docker-compose.yml"); "${compose[@]}" stop rigol-web; cleanup() { kill "${dev_pid:-}" 2>/dev/null || true; "${compose[@]}" up --detach --no-build; }; trap cleanup EXIT; npm run dev & dev_pid=$!; ssh -N -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -R 0.0.0.0:3018:127.0.0.1:5173 fabian@192.168.1.12'
